steps.content: It's finally over.

Max King trudges down the empty corridor, his steps heavy with exhaustion. Shrugging off his coat, he sinks into the chair beside the ward bed. The report in his hand shows that Nirvana's plans are progressing smoothly, but this is not what he has hoped for.

He hopes that the West District can see through Nirvana's conspiracy, that the citizens won't be swayed by illusory promises of wealth, and that the scarce information he possesses can reach those who need it.

But he can do so little, trapped like a fly in a shadowed web. He never knows which corners hide watching eyes, or which walls steal his whispers to the conspirators' ears. Worst of all, he can't be sure who is safe to trust, or how to keep his "friends" from snaring themselves in the same sticky threads.
On the ward bed, Adrian lies deep in slumber. Thanks to the underground doctor ${PlayerName} introduced, his life is no longer in danger, but he still hasn't regained consciousness.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Where are your OWN allies, Mr. King?
Max King sits listening to the steady beep of the heart monitor in silence, his face buried deep in his hands.
[Scene Change]
You're at a discreet, secure meeting point. Having completed your exchange with the disguised agent, you walk toward the door together.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The Fraser delegation's conduct has been acceptable so far. They've provided numerous Aurum Secretum samples and shared significant intelligence regarding the Farland Alliance... though all of it will take time to verify.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Adelaide has been getting quite a lot of media exposure. The press is showing tremendous interest in this alleged brother of Quinn's president. Notably, he appears to enjoy the publicity and seldom declines interview opportunities.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: For now, the identification of Outland extremists remains our top priority. Fraser's intel is helpful, but operational delays are inevitable, especially with the massive abnormal sandstorms crippling FAC's mobility outside the city.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you for your hard work. If you have personnel to spare, I'll leave the list of requirements we just discussed in your hands. That intelligence is very helpful to me.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Understood. We'll contact you immediately when there's any update.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Let me walk you out. You look like you haven't slept properly in days. Madam would tease you if she saw you like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Haha... thanks, but I'll manage. It's no problem.
As you reach the doorway, the agent suddenly stops, the smile on his face turning into something more complex.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: ...Mmm, looks like one of your requests just walked right up to your door.
Following his gaze, you turn toward the entrance, where a woman in red has just parked her car by the road, directly in front of you.

steps.speaker: Woman in Red
steps.content: What happened to you? It's only been a few days and you already look so glum.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Hop in. I'll take you for a drive.
